intro: A familiar voice. A helping hand. Care that stays with you.
name: welcome to Saathi
checkText: No check-in yet today. Your readings will appear here.
routineText: Sit comfortably. Keep your device and amulet nearby.
devicesText: Hardware pairing arrives in a later phase.
roleHelp: Preview the four views on this phone. These are not authenticated accounts.

voice.title: A familiar voice
voice.text: Read-aloud is available when your phone has a suitable voice. Voice commands arrive in Phase 3.
voice.unavailable: No matching voice is available. Install an English or Hindi voice on your phone.
voice.failed: Could not play speech. Try Listen again.

checkPending: Open demo settings to unlock records and replay a check-in.
medPending: No medicines have been added. Medicine scheduling arrives in Phase 3.
familyPending: No family contacts have been added. Contact setup arrives in a later phase.
helpText: This demo cannot send alerts or call your family automatically.
installHelp: On Android Chrome, open the menu and choose Add to Home screen. Use an HTTPS address.
localWarning: Preferences could not be saved. You can continue this session.
emptyText: This phase previews navigation. Patient records and care workflows come next.
familyNext: Loved ones, daily trends and alert responses
ashaNext: Visit lists, offline forms and referrals
doctorNext: Patient timelines, care plans and lab results
privacy: Demo records stay encrypted on this phone after setup.
teamText: Family, ASHA and doctor views share this single-phone demo.
noRecords: Only synthetic records are supported in this demo.
learnText: Big buttons. Clear words. Your preferred language.
speechLocal: Voice availability depends on your phone’s installed language packs.

vault.title: Demo data & privacy
vault.description: Caregiver setup for this single-phone demo.
vault.locked: Your demo records are locked. Enter your PIN.
vault.first: Create a PIN before loading synthetic records.
vault.consent: I agree to store synthetic demo data on this phone.
vault.noRecovery: Remember your PIN. There is no recovery option yet.
vault.eraseConfirm: Delete all demo records and the PIN from this phone.
vault.failed: Could not open or save records. Check your PIN and retry.
vault.scope: Demo roles are not verified identities. No real patient data.
vault.missing: No measurements this day. Previous alert may remain.
vault.guest: Possible guest: device readings excluded from scoring.
vault.plate: Foot contact reading excluded. Check electrode placement.
vault.oxygen: Low oxygen reading triggered this simulated alert.
vault.noPlan: No doctor’s plan has been recorded.
vault.noTreatment: This demo does not suggest medicine changes.

elder.unlock: Ask your caregiver to unlock and load the demo first.
elder.notPrescription: Illustration only. This is not a prescription.
elder.selectDose: Open the practice medicine before marking it taken.
elder.q2: Did you need extra pillows last night?
elder.answersScope: Practice answers stay separate from the recorded device result.
elder.noQuestion: There is no question waiting for an answer.
elder.pendingHelp: Practice dose missed. Caregiver notice pending on this phone.
elder.foreground: Reminders work while this app is open. Closed-app alarms are not guaranteed.
elder.countdown: Help options open in five seconds. Say cancel to stop.
elder.chooseContact: Choose a contact to open the phone dialler.
elder.noContacts: No contacts saved. Ask your caregiver to add them.
elder.noAuto: No call or message has been sent automatically.
elder.unknown: Try saying: medicine, check-in, help, or home.
elder.noWater: No fluid plan or intake log is available.
elder.voiceHelp: Say: medicine, check-in, help, read this, or home.
elder.packText: Install one language pack first. Downloads use about 40 MB.
elder.packFailed: Could not install the pack. Check your connection and retry.
elder.voiceFailed: Voice is unavailable. Use the large buttons or retry.
elder.onlinePrivacy: Optional: browser speech may send audio to its provider.
elder.contactPrivacy: Saved encrypted on this phone. Calls need cellular service.

familyMode.sharedFixture: All demo elders reuse the same synthetic history. Each has separate medicines and responses.
familyMode.trendsScope: Readings up to the selected replay date. Gaps stay visible; excluded readings are not plotted.
familyMode.noReadings: No usable readings in this period.
familyMode.calendarKey: Taken / scheduled doses. A dash means no schedule; green means all taken. This is a record, not a treatment recommendation.
familyMode.noAlerts: No care alerts in this period.
familyMode.clockHelp: Demo clock for the selected historical day. Check at 11:00 or later to flag a missed check-in. Due doses appear in Saathi mode. While the app stays open, reminders also check each minute using India time for this replay day.
familyMode.remindersChecked: Reminders checked for the selected demo day.
familyMode.notSent: On this phone only · not sent
familyMode.nearbyMissing: A verified local facility directory has not been added for your village. Family and ASHA contacts can be saved in Settings.
familyMode.reportsLater: Printable reports and sharing arrive in Phase 7.
familyMode.whyText: Several readings can move away from the elder's usual pattern. An alert asks someone to check the person and follow their recorded clinician plan. It does not diagnose a condition.
familyMode.recordedPlan: Caregiver transcription · clinician review pending. Each checked step is saved with your response.
familyMode.responseScope: Your response does not clear the alert or change the device result. Delivery to the device and ASHA awaits a connection in a later phase.
familyMode.responseSaved: Response saved. Delivery remains pending on this phone.
familyMode.noElderPhone: No elder phone number recorded yet.
familyMode.medicineScope: Manually copy the existing prescription. The app does not choose medicines or doses. Records belong to the synthetic elder selected above.
familyMode.photoPrivacy: JPEG, PNG or WebP up to 5 MB; resized and encrypted locally. No automatic text recognition or upload.
familyMode.prescriptionConfirm: I copied the medicine and schedule from the existing prescription.
familyMode.medicineSaved: Medicine saved. It is available in Saathi mode.
familyMode.invalidMedicine: Check the name, strength, unique times, dose and stock, then retry.
familyMode.photoFailed: Could not use this photo. Choose a JPEG, PNG or WebP under 5 MB.
familyMode.scheduleScope: Schedule starts on {{date}}. It does not create doses before that date.
familyMode.reviseSchedule: To correct a schedule, archive it and add the corrected prescription. Recorded taken doses remain in the calendar.
familyMode.chooseDose: Choose one scheduled dose, then mark it taken.
familyMode.scheduledReminder: Medicine reminder. Check the selected medicine and prescription.
familyMode.transcriptionHelp: Copy existing clinician instructions, one step per line. This is an unverified caregiver transcription until clinician review. Leave the plan empty if none exists.
familyMode.planConfirm: Contact details are correct; any plan text copies existing clinician instructions.
familyMode.careSaved: Care details saved with an audit entry.

notice.missed-dose: A scheduled dose reminder was missed

asha.priorityHelp: Red, then amber, then check-ins missing for more than one day, then green. All dates follow the historical demo.
asha.localStop: Follow-up closed on this phone. The device light stays unchanged.
asha.deliveryHelp: Device/PHC delivery is pending. Nothing has been sent automatically.
asha.formScope: Record observations from the visit. These do not overwrite the device readings.
asha.visitWeight: Visit weight in kg (optional, if no check-in device)
asha.gradeHelp: Use reviewed photo references when available; otherwise drawings are illustrative. Use your training to choose a grade.
asha.notesHelp: Type or dictate locally. Review the transcript before saving. Voice stops after one minute.
asha.callScope: Choosing “Called 108” only records what happened. Calling needs a separate dialler tap.
asha.saveFailed: Could not save. Check both BP values, required answers, medicines and referral reason, then retry.
asha.pdfImageNote: Text is rendered as an image to preserve Hindi shaping. This PDF is not searchable or a signed clinician document.
asha.countScope: Seven calendar days ending on the replay date. Red counts use recorded device results; visits do not clear them.
asha.exportConsent: I reviewed this content and consent to exporting or showing it outside the encrypted vault.
asha.exportReady: PDF downloaded. Its hash is recorded in the encrypted audit trail.
asha.exportFailed: Could not prepare the export. Retry while records are unlocked.
asha.shareOpened: Share request handed to the device. Delivery is not confirmed.
asha.shareUnavailable: File sharing is unavailable here. Share the downloaded PDF from your phone.
asha.qrPrivacy: The QR contains an unencrypted short referral summary, not the full PDF or a secure link. Show it only to the intended care team.
asha.smsHelp: Review the PHC number below. Open an SMS draft to send the weekly counts using cellular SMS, even without internet. The app cannot confirm sending or delivery.
asha.noPHC: Enter a valid PHC number to prepare the SMS draft.
asha.draftSaved: Draft saved. Unlock and reopen this elder to continue.

doctor.name: Doctor name for this demo
doctor.identity: Names identify demo entries only. This phone does not verify clinical credentials.
doctor.planHelp: Enter the existing clinical plan. The app suggests no treatment. New versions start on the selected replay day.
doctor.confirmPlan: I reviewed these instructions and want to save a new plan version.
doctor.planSaved: Plan version saved. Family and ASHA can see it locally; device delivery is pending.
doctor.enteredBy: Doctor demo entry by {{name}}. Identity is unverified.
doctor.sensitivityHelp: Compare the frozen engine on this synthetic history. Saving changes the app setting, not recorded device results.
doctor.confirmSensitivity: Save this threshold with my name. Device update remains pending.
doctor.sensitivitySaved: Sensitivity changed and audited. Recorded lights are unchanged.
doctor.labHelp: Copy the reported value, date and unit. No normal range or treatment advice is inferred.
doctor.labSaved: Lab result saved with author and audit.
doctor.noLabs: No lab results recorded for this date range.
doctor.noteHelp: Notes are shared with Family and ASHA on this phone. Saved notes are append-only.
doctor.noteSaved: Consult note saved and shared locally.
doctor.timelineHelp: Events end on the replay date. Recording timestamps show when this demo phone saved them. Delivery entries are local pending steps.
doctor.noEvents: No events of this type yet.
doctor.familyPlanHelp: Doctor plan text is managed in Doctor mode. You can update the contact number here.
doctor.noIntakeLog: Intake has not been logged, so remaining allowance is unknown.
doctor.trainingHelp: Upload consented, clinically reviewed reference photos for grades 0–3. The named uploader attests review; the app cannot validate grading or credentials.
doctor.exampleConfirm: I have permission to use this photo and reviewed its grade for training.
doctor.exampleSaved: Reference photo saved for the ASHA grade options.

polish.elderContrast: Elder mode always uses high contrast.
polish.draft: Machine translation · needs review. Voice recognition and reports support English/Hindi.
polish.audioHelp: 48 synthetic Hindi clips are saved with the app. They are not human recordings and need listening review.
polish.audioUnavailable: This exact message needs an installed local voice. Read the visible text or ask your caregiver.
polish.languageFailed: Could not switch language. Try again.
polish.reportLanguage: Clinical PDF output is English/Hindi only.
polish.voiceLanguages: Voice recognition supports English and Hindi only.

extra.c84212f3b: Rejected malformed message or wrong device patient ID.
extra.c8d278047: Connection cancelled, unavailable, or failed. Check permissions, HTTPS and device firmware.
extra.c22b7424c: Command written. Wait for the device result; this is not a check-in completion.
extra.c61c06756: Synthetic demo only. The amulet reaches this app through the check-in device; it is not paired directly here.
extra.cf7e37f62: Unlock the vault in Settings first.
extra.cf5ba0fec: Create a separate linked demo elder. Existing fixture records will not be overwritten. Household limit: four.
extra.c6d2bc482: Use Chrome in a secure context. API availability does not guarantee USB-OTG support on your Android phone. No automatic reconnection or treatment commands.
extra.cf334b4bc: Undated history cannot be imported as a batch. Date must be confirmed for each legacy check-in. Conflicting same-day records are rejected.
extra.c88dba5c9: I checked the device ID, dates and synthetic demo records.
extra.cd3a3a827: Import one undated legacy packet at a time.
extra.c7df5dd2a: Device records saved encrypted. Recorded light preserved.
extra.c6c99738: Import rejected: binding, duplicate conflict, date or storage error.
extra.c22228632: Device reported no problems; not independently verified.
extra.c740d2a38: Transfer verified. Received synthetic report; not added to patient records.
extra.c781f7d96: Invalid or conflicting frame. Reset receiver and try again.
extra.c14b39fbe: Camera decode unavailable. Paste frame text below.
extra.c91b7c10e: Camera scanning unavailable or permission denied. Paste QR frame text instead.
extra.cfd18fe0a: PDF saved in the encrypted vault. Ready to download.
extra.c29f63a8b: Could not generate or save report. Check storage and generating name.
extra.c837cd6f9: Action failed or cancelled. Your report remains on this phone.
extra.cf433ba0: Unlock synthetic records in Settings first.
extra.cf90cc9da: Offline synthetic reports. Unknown age, ABHA and device readings stay unrecorded. PDFs use image pages for Hindi shaping. QR transfer carries report data and charts; the receiving phone regenerates the PDF.
extra.c44b33403: I reviewed this synthetic report and allow export outside the encrypted app.
extra.c118096e8: File sharing unavailable. Download PDF and share from Files.
extra.cd9be4288: PDF opened. Use the PDF viewer Print menu.
extra.c86b50f3e: Unencrypted transfer: show only to the intended recipient. SHA-256 checks corruption, not sender identity.
extra.c9d571484: Frames may arrive in any order. Received content is an untrusted synthetic document, never a treatment instruction.
